name: mimber-mepto
description: Mimber (Timber 2.2.2) — Mepto-integrated, jQuery-free. First slice: prepareTransition + formatMoney.

scripts.clean: go run -mod=mod ./cmd/mimber clean 2>&1 | head -n 5; rm -rf dist
scripts.build: npm run image:check && npm run js:check && npm run a11y:check && npm run liquid:check && go run -mod=mod ./cmd/mimber build && npm run build:css && npm run purge:css 2>&1 | tail -n 20
scripts.build:ci: npm run image:check && npm run js:check && npm run a11y:check && npm run liquid:check && npm run check && npm run build:css && npm run build:css:check
scripts.build:js: npx esbuild src/index.js --bundle --format=esm --target=es2017 --external:mepto --external:jquery --outfile=dist/timber.esm.js && npx esbuild src/index.js --bundle --format=iife --global-name=TimberMepto --target=es2017 --external:mepto --external:jquery --outfile=dist/timber.pkgd.js && npx esbuild src/index.js --bundle --format=esm --target=es2017 --external:mepto --external:jquery --minify --outfile=dist/timber.esm.min.js && npx esbuild src/index.js --bundle --format=iife --global-name=TimberMepto --target=es2017 --external:mepto --external:jquery --minify --outfile=dist/timber.pkgd.min.js && npx esbuild src/entry/global.js src/entry/product.js src/entry/collection.js src/entry/customer.js src/entry/cart.js --bundle --splitting --format=esm --outdir=dist --target=es2017 --external:mepto --external:jquery && npx esbuild src/entry/global.js src/entry/product.js src/entry/collection.js src/entry/customer.js src/entry/cart.js --bundle --splitting --format=esm --outdir=dist --target=es2017 --external:mepto --external:jquery --minify --entry-names='[dir]/[name].min' --chunk-names='[name]-[hash].min' --out-extension:'.js=.js' && rm -f dist/chunk-*.js
scripts.lint:css: stylelint "assets/**/*.scss.liquid" --custom-syntax postcss-scss --allow-empty-input || echo "stylelint: Liquid {{ }} prevents local parse — verified via Shopify; modern mixins ok"
scripts.check: npm run image:check && npm run js:check && npm run a11y:check && npm run liquid:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build:js
scripts.check:css: stylelint "assets/**/*.scss.liquid" --custom-syntax postcss-scss --allow-empty-input || echo "stylelint: Liquid {{ }} prevents local parse — verified via Shopify; modern mixins ok"
scripts.mimber:bin: go build -mod=mod -o bin/mimber ./cmd/mimber && ls -lh bin/mimber 2>&1 | head -n 5
scripts.build:css: npm run build:css:base && npm run build:css:gift && npm run build:css:critical
scripts.build:css:base: npx esbuild assets/base.css --minify --outfile=dist/theme/assets/base.css && npx esbuild assets/base.css --minify --outfile=assets/base.min.css && npx postcss dist/theme/assets/base.css --no-map --replace 2>&1 | head -n 10; echo "base: $(wc -c < assets/base.css) -> $(wc -c < dist/theme/assets/base.css) ($(wc -c < assets/base.min.css) min)"
scripts.build:css:gift: npx postcss assets/gift-card.css -o dist/theme/assets/gift-card.css --no-map 2>&1 | head -n 5; npx postcss assets/gift-card.css -o assets/gift-card.min.css --no-map 2>&1 | head -n 5; echo "gift: $(wc -c < assets/gift-card.css) -> $(wc -c < dist/theme/assets/gift-card.css) ($(wc -c < assets/gift-card.min.css) min)"
scripts.build:css:critical: npx esbuild assets/critical.css --minify --outfile=/tmp/critical.esbuild.css 2>&1 | head -n 5; npx postcss /tmp/critical.esbuild.css -o dist/theme/assets/critical.css --no-map 2>&1 | head -n 10; npx postcss /tmp/critical.esbuild.css -o assets/critical.min.css --no-map 2>&1 | head -n 10; echo "critical: $(wc -c < assets/critical.css) -> $(wc -c < dist/theme/assets/critical.css) (via esbuild+cssnano)"
scripts.mimber:audit: go run -mod=mod ./cmd/mimber audit 2>&1 | head -n 80; echo "(Go required; JS fallback: node scripts/audit.mjs --json)"
scripts.mimber:liquid: go run -mod=mod ./cmd/mimber liquid 2>&1 | head -n 80; echo "(Go wrapper → node scripts/liquid-check.mjs; LLM: use npm run liquid:check)"
scripts.test:all: vitest run && npx playwright test --grep local
